request.text: Out of spite, mostly. One greenhouse, one nanofab, a few machines that stayed loyal. Then we woke the Quantum Tubes. Goods pulled to dust here and knitted whole at the far end. After that, dead nodes began waking on their own. Ask an engineer why, and watch them change the subject.
